disclaimer: Get your doctor's OK before you start, and again before you make workouts harder. That is especially important after surgery. You had abdominal surgery in late September 2026, so ease into heavy core work and heavy lifting. Keep the effort controlled. Stop for sharp pain, pulling around the incision, dizziness, or unusual shortness of breath. This is a training template, not medical advice.
weekNote: Sample week: 3 strength days, 2 recumbent-bike days, and mobility. Sunday is rest. Swap Friday for kettlebell conditioning when you want a circuit instead of another strength session.

sessions.name: Strength A
sessions.blurb: Squat, press, row, and hinge with dumbbells, a kettlebell, and the bench. Slow tempo, full control.

exercises.name: Easy bike spin
exercises.cue: Light resistance on the recumbent bike. You should talk in full sentences.

exercises.name: Open book rotation
exercises.cue: Lie on your side on the mat. Open the top arm slowly. Move only as far as the ribs feel easy.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cue: Sit between your hips and stand tall. Knees track over mid-foot. Use the bench if you want a target.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.cue: Feet down, light arch, lower until upper arms are near the bench. Stop before the shoulder pinches.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
exercises.advanced: One-arm row, pause at the hip
exercises.cue: Support yourself on the bench. Pull the elbow toward the hip, not the ceiling.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Soft knees, push hips back, stop when the hamstrings tighten. Keep the weight light while the abdomen is still settling.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell press
exercises.cue: Sit tall on the bench. Press up without shrugging. Use a partial range if the shoulder complains.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.advanced: Dead bug, opposite arm and leg
exercises.cue: Small range. Low back stays gently down. Stop if you feel the incision pull. No sit-ups.

exercises.name: Figure-4 stretch
exercises.cue: On your back, ankle over the opposite knee. Hold in seconds in the reps box. Weight stays 0. Ease off if the hip pinches.

exercises.name: Easy bike cool-down
exercises.cue: Very easy spin. Breathe through the nose if you can.

sessions.name: Strength B
sessions.blurb: Split squat, floor or bench press, hinge, and a short carry. Stay joint-friendly.

exercises.name: Easy bike spin
exercises.cue: Easy recumbent spin. Shoulders relaxed, light hands.

exercises.name: Hip hinge drill
exercises.cue: Hands on thighs, push hips back, then stand. No load.

exercises.name: Split squat
exercises.cue: Short step, front heel down, knee tracks over the toes. Hold the bench if balance wobbles.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press
exercises.cue: Elbows stop on the mat so the shoulder stays in a comfortable range.

exercises.name: Bench-supported dumbbell row
exercises.regression: Row, chest supported on an incline if you prop the bench
exercises.cue: Brace lightly. Do not hold your breath hard. Pull to the hip pocket.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Drive through the heels. Ribs stay down. Skip the dumbbell if the abdomen feels strained.

exercises.name: Farmer march
exercises.cue: Tall posture, short steps. Keep the load modest. Stop if you have to brace so hard the incision area hurts.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cue: Hips stay level. Reach only as far as the low back stays quiet.

exercises.name: Gentle hip flexor stretch
exercises.cue: Half kneeling on the mat, tuck the pelvis slightly. Short hold. Skip it if the abdomen pulls.

exercises.name: Easy bike cool-down
exercises.cue: Easy spin until breathing is quiet.

sessions.name: Strength C
sessions.blurb: Third strength day. Same equipment, slightly different angles, still controlled.

exercises.name: Easy bike spin
exercises.cue: Easy spin. Add no resistance until the legs feel warm.

exercises.name: Ankle rocks
exercises.cue: Stand at the bench, rock the knee gently over the toes. Hold the bench.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cue: Hold one kettlebell at the chest. If that feels heavy, use an empty-hand squat to the bench.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
exercises.cue: Hands on the bench, body in a straight line. Bend the knees if the shoulders or abdomen complain.

exercises.name: Kettlebell deadlift
exercises.regression: Kettlebell deadlift from a raised step
exercises.cue: Hinge, grab the bell, stand tall. The bell can start on a low stack of books or the bench edge if the floor feels too far.

exercises.name: Seated hammer curl
exercises.cue: Sit so the low back does not have to work. Elbows stay near the ribs.

exercises.name: Side-lying clam
exercises.cue: Hips stacked, heels together, small lift. No weight.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.advanced: Dead bug, opposite arm and leg
exercises.cue: Exhale as the leg reaches. Keep the range small. This is not a crunch.

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.cue: On your back, one knee bent, hold the thigh. Log seconds. Do not pull the leg straight if the back rounds.

exercises.name: Quiet breathing
exercises.cue: On the mat, one hand on the belly, easy breaths. No forceful bracing.

sessions.name: Kettlebell circuit
sessions.blurb: Slow kettlebell circuit. Rounds and rest follow your level. Swings are a later option, not the default.

exercises.name: Easy bike spin
exercises.cue: Short easy spin before you pick up the bell.

exercises.name: Kettlebell deadlift
exercises.cue: Brace lightly, stand tall, set the bell down each rep. Do not bounce.

exercises.name: Kettlebell goblet squat
exercises.cue: Elbows inside the knees at the bottom only if that feels roomy. Otherwise stay higher.

exercises.name: Kettlebell halo
exercises.cue: Circle the bell slowly around the head. Keep the ribs stacked. Skip it if the shoulder clicks.

exercises.name: Kettlebell row
exercises.cue: Hinge and support the free hand on the knee or bench. Pull to the hip.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: No bell on the hips. Ribs down.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: Easy reps to finish. Stop if the abdomen pulls.

exercises.name: Easy bike cool-down
exercises.cue: Walk the heart rate down on the bike.

sessions.name: Bike, steady
sessions.blurb: Easy-to-moderate steady spin. Duration grows with your level. You should still be able to talk.

exercises.name: Bike warm-up
exercises.cue: Very easy. Check that the seat leaves a soft bend in the knee.

exercises.name: Steady bike
exercises.cue: Conversational pace. Resistance you can hold without rocking the torso.

exercises.name: Bike cool-down
exercises.cue: Ease the resistance off and spin lightly.

exercises.name: Figure-4 stretch
exercises.cue: On the mat after the bike. Hold in seconds. Both sides, one after the other.

sessions.name: Bike, intervals
sessions.blurb: Short harder efforts with easy spinning between them. Stay seated and keep the torso quiet.

exercises.name: Bike warm-up
exercises.cue: Easy spin. Add a few 20-second faster turns only if they feel smooth.

exercises.name: Bike intervals
exercises.cue: Harder minutes are a notch above steady, not a sprint. Easy minutes are truly easy. Stay seated. Stop the set if you get dizzy.

exercises.name: Bike cool-down
exercises.cue: Light spin until breathing settles.

exercises.name: Quiet breathing
exercises.cue: On the mat. Nasal breaths if comfortable. No bracing.

sessions.name: Mat mobility
sessions.blurb: Yoga-mat flexibility and easy core. Nothing ballistic, no sit-ups, no long levers until they feel ordinary.

exercises.name: Supine knee rocks
exercises.cue: On your back, knees bent, rock them slowly side to side. Small range.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.cue: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips. Move with the breath. Skip if wrists complain and do it seated instead.

exercises.name: Open book rotation
exercises.cue: Side-lying. Follow the hand with your eyes. Keep the range comfortable through the ribs.

exercises.name: Figure-4 stretch
exercises.cue: Ankle over the knee. Hold, then switch. Do not press the knee hard.

exercises.name: Gentle hip flexor stretch
exercises.cue: Half kneeling. Slight pelvic tuck. Skip if the front of the abdomen pulls.

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.cue: On your back, hold behind the thigh with the knee a little bent.

exercises.name: Thoracic reach
exercises.cue: On all fours, one hand behind the head, rotate only as far as the neck stays easy.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: Tiny reach of the heel. Low back stays quiet. This replaces crunches.

exercises.name: Side-lying wind-down
exercises.cue: Lie on your side, top knee bent on the mat, breathe. Then switch.

exercises.name: Quiet breathing
exercises.cue: On your back, knees bent. Easy belly breaths, not a hard brace.

sessions.name: Level 2 strength
sessions.blurb: When the beginner sessions feel ordinary. A light kettlebell swing, a step-up, a one-arm press, and a seated raise. Keep the load light and do not brace hard.

exercises.name: Easy bike spin
exercises.cue: Easy recumbent spin. You should talk in full sentences.

exercises.name: Hip hinge drill
exercises.cue: Hands on the thighs, push the hips back, then stand. No load.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
exercises.cue: Light bell only. Hike it back, snap the hips, and let it float to chest height. Exhale on the way up. Stop if the abdomen pulls. No hard brace.

exercises.name: Dumbbell step-up
exercises.cue: Whole foot on the bench. Stand tall. Use a low bench if the knee or abdomen complains.

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell bench press
exercises.cue: One light bell. The free hand rests on the ribs. Feet stay down. Do not hold the breath.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell raise
exercises.cue: Sit tall so the low back does not have to work. Lift only to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.advanced: Dead bug, opposite arm and leg
exercises.cue: Small range. Low back stays gently down. Stop if the incision pulls.

exercises.name: Easy bike cool-down
exercises.cue: Very easy spin. Breathe quietly.
